title: Sources: Jensen Huang developed a close relationship with Trump and made lobbying calls to secure AI chip sales to China, which he called a $50B per year market (Ian Duncan/Washington Post)
summary: Ian Duncan / Washington Post: Sources: Jensen Huang developed a close relationship with Trump and made lobbying calls to secure AI chip sales to China, which he called a $50B per year market — Jensen Huang wooed the president and pushed back against lawmakers as Nvidia sought a foothold in the vast Chinese market.
